alias_kinds.historical_surface_alias: A former or abbreviated SurfaceIdentity value that canonicalizes to exactly one canonical surface when read as a surface value. It canonicalizes to a current surface, or to the successor of a superseded one; an alias of a retired surface without a successor keeps that retired coordinate and admits no new use.

surfaces.description: Registered in error as a Claude Code desktop application surface. Retired by owner decision on 2026-11-20 with no successor; Claude Code has exactly two surfaces, claude-code-cli and claude-code-web. The coordinate stays addressable for historical resolution and admits no new use. The same string is a historical ActorIdentity alias in actor_registry.yaml; equal strings do not imply equal identity kinds.
The Claude Code local command-line surface, including the command line run inside an IDE.

Registered in error as a Claude Code IDE-extension surface. Retired by owner decision on 2026-11-20 with no successor; the command line run inside an IDE is claude-code-cli. The coordinate stays addressable for historical resolution and admits no new use.
The Claude Code hosted cloud-session surface, whichever client starts the session, a phone included.

Registered as a separate Claude Code mobile surface. Superseded by owner decision on 2026-11-20 by claude-code-web; a cloud session started from a phone is a Claude Code web session. The same string is a historical ActorIdentity alias in actor_registry.yaml; equal strings do not imply equal identity kinds.
A human operator's direct shell surface.
